method.unit: an O*NET 31.0 task statement, weighted in job-equivalents (OEWS May 2025 employment of its occupation, split across the occupation's tasks by importance)
method.sample: 1,500 tasks, PPS by weight within SOC major group (experiments/taxonomy/README.md)
method.share: count share of sampled tasks (the brief's headline, with a binomial SE; approximately the employment-weighted share, not exactly, because certainty tasks count once but stand for more weight); share_ht is the Horvitz-Thompson ratio with weight/inclusion_prob, the design-consistent estimate (SE: with-replacement within group, certainty tasks add no variance). Where they differ, trust share_ht
method.units: shares, automation included, are fractions; Economic Index usage (*_pct, usage_sum, sampled_usage_sum, calibration, median_usage) is in percent of the platform's conversations
method.three_ways: A and B are each rater over all tasks; agreed is the subset where A == B (not a random subset); mean is the average of A and B
method.errors_not_in_se: standard errors are sampling error only; rater disagreement is the A/B spread
method.job_zone: O*NET 31.0 Job Zones.txt; zones 1 and 2 are one category ('Job Zone 1-2') in this release
method.bls_ep: BLS Employment Projections, Table 5.4 Education and training assignments by detailed occupation, 2025; joined on SOC code, then OEWS code
method.aei: Anthropic Economic Index release release_2026_06_26, GLOBAL, month 2026-05 unless noted; task rows joined on O*NET Task ID, occupation rows on O*NET-SOC code
method.gdpval: occupations only, as OEWS codes from weights.json (gdpval_join); no GDPval text
